description: This file defines the LocationType class, a custom form type for handling location input in a Symfony-based PHP application. It manages configuration options, form building, view customization, and view finalization for location data, including coordinates and address details.

classes.name: LocationType
classes.description: A custom Symfony form type extending TextType to handle location data with configurable options, form building, and view rendering.

methods.name: configureOptions
methods.description: Sets default options for the LocationType form, including location class, radius, and fields to populate.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the form fields for location data, including address components and a formatted address, and applies a view transformer to convert between location object and array.

methods.name: buildView
methods.description: Customizes the form view variables, including row class, populate fields, and location object details.

methods.name: finishView
methods.description: Finalizes the form view by adding data attributes for geocoder type and item, and ensures the location input has the correct CSS classes.

methods.name: getBlockPrefix
methods.description: Returns the block prefix 'location' for this form type.
